description: Add a read-only, project-scoped stage-duration surface (per-stage avg/median, flow-efficiency ratio, wait breakout) derived purely from already-persisted events, plus a Dashboard Productivity-zone widget rendering the stage-duration distribution as horizontal bars with an avg/median lens toggle, the flow-efficiency ratio, and the wait breakout.

tasks.title: Implement backend stage-duration metrics surface (querier + endpoint + DTOs + tests)
tasks.description: Add an additive project-scoped read surface `GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/metrics/stage-duration` mapped in `IssueRoutes.MapIssueRoutes` (new `IssueRoutes.StageDurationMetrics.cs`), backed by a new `IssueQuerier.GetStageDurationsAsync(projectId, now)` method. Inject `TimeProvider` (no wall clock) and scope the aggregation to delivered issues completed within the fixed 30-day trailing window shared with delivery-time (anchored on `Issue.CompletedAt`). Derive, purely from already-persisted events: per-stage latest-attempt duration from `StageStarted`→`StageCompleted` (ordering by `(Time, Id)` across the issue's full run history), per-stage average + median + sample count, the population-weighted flow-efficiency ratio (Σ activeWork ÷ Σ cycleTime over issues with defined positive cycle), and the wait breakout (average approval-gate wait reusing the approval-waiting-metrics definition over completed approvals, plus average inactive-gap). Cycle decomposes into three non-overlapping non-negative components that sum to cycle by construction: active-work = Σ(stage durations) − approvalGateWait; inactiveGap = cycle − Σ(stage durations). Add the nullable-DTO response shape mirroring `ApprovalWaitMetricsResponse` so empty (no delivered issues → 200 with empty stages array, null ratio, null wait fields, zero sample counts) is distinguishable from undefined (started-but-never-completed latest attempt → excluded sample) and from a genuine zero-duration stage. Add a stage-duration event loader selecting `Source/Id/Type/Time/Data` over BOTH `StageStarted` and `StageCompleted` types — the existing `LoadWorkflowRunEventFactsAsync` selects `Source/Id/Type/Data` only AND filters by `QualityWorkflowEventTypes`, which omits `StageCompleted`, so it cannot be reused as-is (no schema change; `Time` already exists on `WorkflowRunEventRow`). Keep existing delivery-time/approval/quality surfaces and contracts untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/metrics/stage-duration` returns 200 with per-stage average, median, and sample count (ordered by workflow stage order), the flow-efficiency ratio, and the wait breakout for a project with delivered issues in the window (spec: 'Client reads the stage-duration surface for a project').

A stage reached by no delivered issue is absent from the result; a stage whose latest attempt started but never completed contributes no defined sample (excluded from avg/median/count, never coerced to zero) (spec: 'A started-but-never-completed latest attempt yields an undefined stage duration', 'Stages are ordered by workflow stage order').

Latest-attempt-per-stage is taken across the issue's full run history by `(Time, Id)` order; a re-attempted stage uses the latest attempt and earlier invalidated attempts are NOT averaged or summed (spec: 'A re-attempted stage uses the latest attempt, not the earlier one', 'The latest attempt is taken across the issue's workflow runs').

Average and median are computed per stage over defined samples only; the odd/even median formula reuses the one from `GetApprovalWaitAsync` so surfaces agree (spec: 'Average and median are computed per stage from the defined samples').

Cycle decomposition holds: activeWork + approvalGateWait + inactiveGap == cycleTime per delivered issue; approval-gate wait counts only completed (approved/rejected) approvals, pending (awaiting) approvals contribute nothing (spec: 'The three components sum to the cycle time', 'Approval-gate wait reuses the approval-waiting-metrics definition', 'An issue with no approval gates has zero approval-gate wait').

Flow-efficiency ratio is the population-weighted Σ activeWork ÷ Σ cycleTime over issues with defined strictly-positive cycle (NOT the arithmetic mean of per-issue ratios); issues with undefined/zero cycle are excluded from numerator and denominator (spec: 'The ratio is the population weighted ratio of active-work over cycle time', 'Issues without a defined or positive cycle time are excluded from the ratio').

Wait breakout returns the average approval-gate wait and average inactive-gap per delivered issue with a defined cycle, over the same population; zero-wait issues contribute zero rather than exclusion (spec: 'The breakout returns average approval-wait and average inactive-gap per issue', 'An issue with no wait contributes zero to the averages, not exclusion').

Membership is keyed on completion time within the fixed (not caller-configurable) trailing window shared with delivery-time; a project with no delivered issues in the window returns 200 with the defined empty result (empty stages array, null ratio, null wait fields, zero sample counts) (spec: 'Only issues delivered within the trailing window contribute', 'No delivered issues in the window yields an empty result, not an error').

A genuine zero-duration stage (same StageStarted and StageCompleted moment) is reported as a real value with a non-zero sample count, distinguishable from the empty result (spec: 'A genuine zero-duration stage is distinguishable from the empty result').

Unknown project returns 404; existing delivery-time/approval/quality endpoints and DTOs remain unchanged (spec: 'Unknown project returns not found', 'Existing project issue-metrics contracts are preserved').

The surface introduces no new events, persisted fields, schema change, or domain writes; it mutates no issue/session/workflow/approval state (spec: 'Durations are derived only from already-persisted events', 'Reading the surface mutates no domain state').

Querier unit specs in `IssueQuerierSpecs.cs` (multi-run latest-attempt, cross-run latest pair, exclude-undefined, sum-to-cycle decomposition, population-weighted ratio, wait-breakout averages, window membership, empty-vs-zero distinguishability, project scoping) pass, and API specs in `IssueMetricsApiSpecs.cs` (200 happy path, empty result, 404 unknown project, injected-clock window) pass with `TreatWarningsAsErrors`.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Api/IssueRoutes.StageDurationMetrics.cs (endpoint + BuildResponse), new response DTO in IssueRoutes.Dtos.cs, IssueQuerier.GetStageDurationsAsync (+ result records) in packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueQuerier.cs, the Time-column extension on the stage-event loader, route registration in IssueRoutes.MapIssueRoutes, and the matching spec tests in packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Issue/.
tasks.notes: Follow the established in-memory aggregation idiom (EF Core SQLite cannot translate DateTimeOffset against TEXT columns): fetch candidate rows unfiltered and aggregate in memory, exactly as GetDeliveryTimesAsync / GetQualityAsync do. Reuse the GetQualityAsync pattern (scan IssueEvents for IssueWorkStarted/IssueWorkCompleted payloads to collect workflowRunIds, union with issue.WorkflowRunId, then load stage events by those run sources) for cross-run stage-event discovery. Reuse ReadWorkflowRunId / ReadWorkflowEventStage (camel/Pascal tolerant). The median odd/even formula MUST match GetApprovalWaitAsync exactly.

tasks.title: Implement Dashboard stage-duration widget (query hook + chart + Productivity-zone mount + tests)
tasks.description: Add a `StageDurationChart` widget to the Dashboard Productivity zone (next to `CycleTimeChart`), plus a new TanStack Query hook under `entities/issue/api/` consuming the T-001 `stage-duration` endpoint. Render one horizontal bar per reached workflow stage (in workflow stage order), with bar length encoding the stage's average or median duration per the selected lens (average/median segmented control, identical in shape to `CycleTimeChart`'s lead/cycle toggle). Surface the flow-efficiency ratio and the wait breakout (average approval-gate wait and average inactive-gap per delivered issue) next to the bars, all sourced from the backend surface (never computed client-side from a partial sample). Render the horizontal-bar geometry locally inside `StageDurationChart` (the shared kit only has vertical bar primitives; mirror the `CycleTimeChart`'s local `PercentileOverlay` precedent) while composing the baseline wrappers: `ChartContainer` (loading/error/empty three-state with a concrete empty next action — 'stage durations appear once an issue completes on the project'), `ChartAccessibility` (sr-only summary + a legend that disambiguates stage bars / ratio / wait-breakout components by a channel other than color), `ChartAxes`, `ChartLegend`, `useReducedMotion`, theme-token color classes (`fill-chart-*`), `tabular-nums`, and `transform: scaleX(ratio)` with left `transformOrigin` for bar motion (never animate width/height; honor `prefers-reduced-motion`). Both lenses from a single backend read (no second fetch on lens switch). Mount the widget in `ProductivityZone`.
acceptanceCriteria: Productivity zone renders one horizontal bar per workflow stage reached by at least one delivered issue, ordered by workflow stage order (plan → build → check → integrate), with bar lengths from the stage-duration surface (spec: 'One bar renders per stage, length from that stage's average duration', 'Bar values come from the stage-duration surface, not a new collection').

An average lens and a median lens are both available as a segmented control (`role="group"`, `aria-pressed`); selecting the median lens re-renders bar lengths to the per-stage median with no second fetch (spec: 'Both lenses are available on the chart', 'Bar lengths follow the selected lens').

The flow-efficiency ratio is displayed next to the bars and is sourced from the surface, not computed client-side (spec: 'The flow-efficiency ratio is displayed next to the bars'); when the surface returns the empty result the widget renders the empty state and fabricates no ratio (spec: 'The ratio is not fabricated client-side when absent').

The wait breakout shows the average approval-gate wait and average inactive-gap per delivered issue, both from the surface; pending (awaiting) approvals are not shown as wait here (spec: 'The wait breakout shows average approval wait and average inactive gap', 'Pending approvals are not shown as wait time in this chart').

Loading state renders while the data is in flight, error state renders on fetch failure, and the empty state renders with a concrete next action ('stage durations appear once an issue completes on the project') and no bare empty coordinate axis — all routed through the shared `ChartContainer` three-state wrapper (spec: 'Loading state renders while data is in flight', 'Error state renders when the data fetch fails', 'Empty state renders with a next action and no bare axis').

Widget composes the dashboard-charts baseline only: pinned chart library (no new dependency), theme-token colors (`fill-chart-*`), the accessibility wrapper whose legend distinguishes stage bars / ratio / wait-breakout components by a non-color channel (label/shape/pattern), `tabular-nums`, and `transform: scaleX(...)`-based motion with left origin honoring `prefers-reduced-motion` (spec: 'Widget uses the chart baseline components and conventions', 'Accessibility wrapper distinguishes bars and wait components without color alone').
The trailing window is fixed and not user-configurable, matching the backend (spec: 'The trailing window is fixed and not configurable').

Widget is purely read-only: viewing/refreshing it performs no write or mutation against issue/session/workflow/approval state and introduces no new backend write, event, or collection beyond the additive stage-duration read (spec: 'Widget is read-only with respect to domain state').

Component tests cover: three-state rendering (loading/error/empty with next action), bar count/order/values sourced from the surface, lens toggle switching bar lengths, ratio + wait-breakout values sourced from the surface, theme-token color usage, and `transform`-based / `prefers-reduced-motion`-aware motion; the query-hook test covers the request/response shape and error path. All pass via the web package test/typecheck commands.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/entities/issue/api/stage-duration.ts (+ .test.ts), packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/productivity/StageDurationChart.tsx (+ .test.tsx), the ProductivityZone.tsx mount, and any local chart-geometry helpers co-located with the chart.
tasks.notes: Consumes the T-001 endpoint contract; if T-001 has not landed the widget routes fetch failure through the existing three-state error shell (no regression to other charts), so web and server are independent additive reads — but implement against the T-001 DTO shape. Render horizontal bars locally (do NOT add a HorizontalBarSeries to the shared kit — only one consumer, matches the PercentileOverlay precedent and the 'Modified Capabilities: None' constraint). No third-party chart dependency.
